1A2P_trimmed.cif.edit_rationale: Same rationale as 5i55/PROVENANCE.json. Verified by real-Gemmi reparse diff of category_names before/after.

1A2P_ncs_isolated.cif.role: MINOR-6 (adversarial review 20261125) explicit NCS-isolation derivative of 1A2P_trimmed.cif, under the frozen §23 lineage allowance - labeled honestly as a derivative, never presented as the intact deposition
1A2P_ncs_isolated.cif.edit_rationale: 1A2P_trimmed.cif's full end-to-end pipeline (chain A selected, ZN/HOH dispositioned to 'remove') never reaches the _struct_ncs_oper guard at all: it raises UNSUPPORTED_SYMMETRY first, from exactly one real struct_conn row - metalc2 (A GLU 60 OE2, ptnr1_symmetry='3_675', to chain D's Zn) - whose non-identity crystallographic symmetry this profile has no _symmetry_equiv/_space_group_symop table to prove. That row is the *sole* line removed here (verbatim line match, single occurrence, verified byte-identical before/after on every other line via diff), isolating the full pipeline from this single, unrelated, genuinely real finding about the chain A/D metal coordination so the real NCS operators can reach the full production entry point. Every other real struct_conn row (metalc1/metalc3, both chain A/D at identity 1_555, and all of chains B/C's metalc4-12) is untouched and byte-identical to 1A2P_trimmed.cif.

_struct_conn: metalc2 (A GLU 60 OE2 -> D ZN, ptnr1_symmetry=3_675)

scenario_usage.id: T021-150-154 (ncs-*) - real _struct_ncs_oper rows, both via the pure NCS guard in isolation and via the full production pipeline on the isolation derivative
scenario_usage.note_honest_limitation: 1A2P_trimmed.cif's own full end-to-end materialize_receptor_cif021() (chain A selected, ZN/HOH dispositioned to 'remove') does NOT reach a successful plan: a separate, unrelated real struct_conn row (metalc2, A-D, ptnr1_symmetry='3_675') requires resolving a true crystallographic symmetry operator this profile has no _symmetry_equiv/_space_group_symop table to prove, and correctly raises UNSUPPORTED_SYMMETRY - this is itself a genuine, honestly-reported finding about this specific real deposition's crystallography (a real metal coordination to a symmetry-related copy), not a defect in the NCS handling and not worked around. This original negative outcome is preserved and still tested against 1A2P_trimmed.cif itself, unchanged. The two real _struct_ncs_oper rows (id 1/2, both code='given', confirmed non-identity-irrelevant per the frozen rule 'given' never requires an identity check) are exercised three ways: (1) extracted verbatim and run through compute_category_decisions()/the pure NCS guard in isolation; (2) through 1A2P_ncs_isolated.cif's full real production pipeline (this derivative), which now reaches and resolves the _struct_ncs_oper category end to end; (3) the original 1A2P_trimmed.cif's honest full-pipeline refusal, kept as-is.
scenario_usage.expected_outcome_ncs_guard: _struct_ncs_oper category decision action='guard_then_omit', both real rows omitted-audited, no UNSUPPORTED_NCS/INVALID_CIF raised for either (both code='given', values taken verbatim from the deposition) - true both in the isolated guard call and in 1A2P_ncs_isolated.cif's full pipeline result.
